statement: The push gate cannot report success, or be run, without having proven what it claims. (G1, R23) gateExactSha (scripts/checks/push-gate-corpus-worktree.js) and the publisher's gateExactHead (scripts/publish-head.js) run the gate in a checkout inside the enclosing repository's test-output/; a gate command that removed or replaced the checkout's .git link made the post-run status read discover the ENCLOSING repository, which ignores test-output/, and pass (exit 0, stray files and all). Now one identity owner in publish-head.js (checkoutIdentity / exactCheckoutStatus) records the checkout's .git link, the gitdir it resolves to and HEAD = the gated sha before the run and compares them after; every read stops discovery at the checkout (gitProcessEnvironment(base, checkout) sets GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES, also exported to the whole gate run) and the status is read through the recorded gitdir; identity lost is the typed refusal checkout-identity-lost, diagnostics are kept and nothing is stranded (removeWorktree prunes after the directory is gone). (G2) A stop request is honoured: the gate installs no signal handler (one only replaced the default action while spawnSync blocked, swallowing a SIGTERM sent to the gate alone), so the gate ends by the signal; its command runs under a supervisor (the gate script, --supervise) in its own process group, which forwards signals and, when the gate process is gone, stops the group, keeps the diagnostics and removes the checkout; a checkout stranded outside that window records its owner and is released by the next gate. (G3) Every gate, publisher, solver and lab entry point with side effects refuses an argument it does not know, with a usage line and a non-zero exit, before any work (push-gate-change-proof.js --help ran the whole placed corpus). (G4) retainGateDiagnostics never prunes the run it just wrote, prunes only sha-named entries, and orders by mtime then name. (G5) The runner echoes a failing test's stdout and stderr indented and line-terminated, so no echoed line can be read as a runner verdict, summary, plan, retried-once or relayed line by any reader (TEST_FILE_LINE's owner).

constraints.statement: Existing files change; no file is added under scripts/ and no workflow is added; the receipt is produced by the existing harness runtime; ratchet baselines only tighten.

The checkout identity and the status read after a gate are defined once (publish-head.js) and used by both the direct-push gate and the publisher; no git read in either gate discovers past its checkout.

gateExactSha stays synchronous; only the supervisor of its command is event-driven, and stranded-checkout cleanup is owned (the owner record beside each checkout) and bounded (the next gate releases it).
An unknown argument is refused before any child process, network call, lab placement or write; the witness observes this, it does not time it.
Echoed test output is made unparseable at the one owner of the runner line shapes (run-test-files.js); no reader gains its own defence.
